title: Nutty
description:
Defined by generous ceiling heights, the project addresses the challenge of creating an interior that is both elegant and welcoming, without compromising a sense of openness and spatial continuity.

Natural materials play a central role in the architectural composition. Walnut wood introduces depth and warmth, entering into a subtle dialogue with light, restrained walls and refined mineral surfaces.

The workspace incorporates a custom-designed desk, conceived specifically for the home office, ensuring balanced proportions and seamless integration within the overall design.

Wood flooring reinforces the residential character of the interior, adding texture and comfort while contributing to the material equilibrium of the space.

A carefully considered lighting strategy enhances the materiality of each element, creating a calm and intimate atmosphere despite the scale of the volumes.
